metaTitle: Free Plumber Invoice Template — No Signup, No Watermark
metaDescription: Free plumber invoice template for billing service calls, parts, and labor — no signup, no watermark. Download an editable Word and PDF invoice or make one online.
intro: This is a free plumber invoice template made for plumbing pros — service techs, drain cleaners, and independent plumbing contractors who bill for a call-out, labor hours, and the parts they install. It splits the work into clear lines so a homeowner or property manager can see the call-out fee, the hours on the job, and every fitting or fixture they are paying for.

It is free to use, with no signup and no watermark. Download the editable Word and PDF files and fill them in on your own computer, or use the generator below to build the invoice in your browser and download a print-ready PDF in a couple of minutes.
included: A line for your service call or call-out fee, plus labor lines by the hour, so emergency and after-hours visits are easy to bill
Parts and materials lines for fittings, valves, water heaters, or a new faucet, each with quantity and unit price
A header for your business name, logo, phone, address, and license number, and a section for the customer and the service address
A unique invoice number with issue and due dates so every job is easy to track and reference
Automatic subtotal, tax, and grand total, plus a notes and payment-terms area for deposits, warranty details, or Net 15
Free editable Word and PDF files, print-ready on one page, with no watermark and no signup

steps.title: Add your business, customer, and service address
steps.body: Put your company name, logo, license number, and phone at the top, then add the customer and the address where the work was done. Give the invoice a unique number and set the issue and due dates.

steps.title: List the call-out, labor, and parts
steps.body: Add a line for the service call fee, then your labor hours and rate, then each part you installed — a shut-off valve, a wax ring, a water heater. The template adds up the line totals, subtotal, tax, and grand total for you.

steps.title: Download and send
steps.body: Download a print-ready PDF (or the editable Word file) and hand it over on site or email it to the homeowner or property manager. Note your payment terms and any warranty on the parts and labor.

faqs.q: How do I bill a call-out fee and labor on the same plumbing invoice?
faqs.a: Use separate lines. Put the service call or call-out fee on its own line, then add your labor as one or more lines with the hours and your hourly rate. List any parts you installed as their own lines with quantity and unit price. The template totals everything into a subtotal, adds tax, and shows one grand total, so the customer sees the full cost and the breakdown behind it.

faqs.q: How should I charge for an emergency or after-hours plumbing call?
faqs.a: Bill it the same way, just with your emergency rate. Note on the call-out line that it was an after-hours or weekend visit and use the higher rate you quoted, then add labor and parts as usual. Stating the emergency rate before you head out, and repeating it in the notes area, keeps the invoice from being a surprise.

faqs.q: Should I charge sales tax on a plumbing invoice?
faqs.a: It depends on your state and the type of work. In the US, many states tax the parts and materials a plumber installs, and some tax repair labor while others do not, so the rules vary by state and job. The template has a tax line that calculates automatically — set the rate that applies to the parts or labor you are billing, and check your state's rules if you are unsure.

faqs.q: Is the template really free with no watermark?
faqs.a: Yes. The Word and PDF files are free to download and use, with no signup and no watermark. You can reuse them for every customer and job and edit them however you like.
